question: How is Mount Maṇikūṭa directly addressed in this invocation?
premises: It is called the best of mountains.
It is described as yellow-colored and three-eyed.
inference: Mount Maṇikūṭa is invoked as the supreme, yellow-colored, three-eyed mountain.
plain_english: O Maṇikūṭa, best of mountains, yellow-colored, three-eyed one.
